How to choose: reply with one child code and one adult code, for example “K1 + A1”. You can also mix, for example “K2 but with K1’s colors” or “A4 layout with A1 fonts”. Whatever you pick will also cover the cooking game, the parent setup, the PIN screen, the “Who is cooking today?” screen and dark mode. Prices and stats shown here are placeholders for layout only.
